title: CmdPal: Icons (4/n) - Prioritize live icon requests and load glyphs directly
summary: The current upstream head still contains three correctness issues found by the converged fork review: XamlRoot event subscriptions can duplicate and stale unload handling can invalidate a rebound control; ETW-only diagnostics do not record speculative deferrals because they bypass the current-session accessor; and completion can retain the demand worker reserve, stranding accepted speculative work during shutdown. A candidate patch containing all three fixes and a regression test was applied to the exact upstream head and passed the targeted build and tests.

proposed_comments.title: Keep IconBox XamlRoot subscriptions and stale unload handling consistent
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep IconBox XamlRoot subscriptions and stale unload handling consistent

**Severity:** `high`

In `IconBox.OnLoaded` and `OnUnloaded` (around lines 190-221), subscribe through a tracked XamlRoot: unsubscribe the previously tracked root before subscribing to a new one, clear the tracked root on unload, and treat any loaded, in-bounds unload as stale even when `_activeRequestDemand` is already null. Otherwise repeated load cycles can duplicate `Changed` callbacks, unsubscribe the wrong root after a root transition, or invalidate a rebound control after its request has completed.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction spans IconBox loaded/unloaded lifecycle state and event subscription ownership; it cannot be expressed safely as one current RIGHT-side inline suggestion.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The correction spans IconBox loaded/unloaded lifecycle state and event subscription ownership; it cannot be expressed safely as one current RIGHT-side inline suggestion.

confidence.rationale: The current code subscribes directly on every load, removes the handler from the current rather than tracked root, and gates the stale-unload guard on an active request. The exact-head candidate correction builds successfully and is covered by the existing IconBox lifecycle behavior.

proposed_comments.title: Use the current diagnostics session accessor for ETW-only listeners
proposed_comments.body:
### Use the current diagnostics session accessor for ETW-only listeners

**Severity:** `medium`

`BeginSpeculativeDispatchDeferral` currently reads `_activeSession` directly, while the rest of the diagnostics lifecycle uses `GetCurrentSession()` and `IsCurrentSession(...)`. That bypasses the ETW-only session path, so speculative-deferral measurements are missing whenever an external ETW listener activates diagnostics without a text report. Use the current-session accessor here and keep the measurement validity check aligned with the same session identity rules.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The fix must stay aligned with the diagnostics session identity rules and related tests, so it is recorded as a companion request rather than a single-line patch.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The fix must stay aligned with the diagnostics session identity rules and related tests, so it is recorded as a companion request rather than a single-line patch.

confidence.rationale: The accessor mismatch is visible in the current head and the exact-head candidate passed the ETW listener and speculative measurement tests.

proposed_comments.title: Release the demand reserve when completion drains speculative work
proposed_comments.body:
### Release the demand reserve when completion drains speculative work

**Severity:** `high`

`Complete()` currently closes demand admission but leaves `_workerSlotsReservedForDemand` active. If accepted speculative work remains queued and all available workers are counted against that reserve, `CanDispatchNextWorkItem()` can refuse to dispatch the remaining speculative items and shutdown can wait indefinitely. Once completion is requested, stop reserving a worker for future demand and stop recording reserve deferrals so accepted speculative work can drain. Add a regression test for completion with a two-worker queue and queued speculative work.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The change requires coordinated queue-completion logic and regression coverage, so it is not safe as one localized apply-ready suggestion.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The change requires coordinated queue-completion logic and regression coverage, so it is not safe as one localized apply-ready suggestion.

confidence.rationale: The deadlock condition is directly exercised by the candidate regression test CompletionReleasesDemandReserveToDrainSpeculativeWork, which passed along with the full 65-test icon filter.
